# dgrid_from_atoms_aabb_interp_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.dgrid_from_atoms_aabb_interp_rust }

```python
rust_fun.dgrid_from_atoms_aabb_interp_rust(
    ase_atoms,
    spacing,
    coarse_factor=2,
    radii=None,
    n_neighbors=10,
)
```

Compute a smoothed distance grid using coarse AABB sampling + trilinear interpolation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                 | Default    |
|---------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms     |        | ASE Atoms object containing the atomic structure                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| spacing       |        | Grid spacing in Angstroms (fine grid)                                                                                                                       | _required_ |
| coarse_factor |        | Coarsening factor (>1) for the AABB sampling grid; 2 is a mild smoothing                                                                                    | `2`        |
| radii         |        | Van der Waals radii for each atom. If None, uses Bondi (1964) handbook radii with Mendeleev fill (:func:`~mofography.vdw_radii.default_vdw_radii_angstrom`) | `None`     |
| n_neighbors   |        | Number of nearest neighbors to query from the AABB tree, defaults to 10                                                                                     | `10`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | 3D distance grid (float32) with mild smoothing from interpolation |
